integrity: The proof derives annihilator-graph adjacency exactly from coordinate supports and then characterizes every dominating edge by intersection and union obstructions. Direct finite-ring computations are corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The support classification is restricted to finite reduced commutative rings, equivalently finite products of fields.
Only minimum total and paired dominating sets are classified and counted; higher-cardinality enumerators are not determined.
No extension to nonreduced finite rings is claimed.
title: Minimum paired dominating edges in annihilator graphs of finite reduced rings
